title: Dialects, Architecture, and Regional Pride
grammar: Synthesis of spatial postpositions: innen, túl, szerte, mentén, táján, végig
goal: I can synthesize the cultural geography of Hungarian regions through dialects and vernacular architecture.
I can deploy the full inventory of B2 spatial postpositions in complex descriptive sentences.
I can compare regional identities across the Carpathian Basin with cultural sensitivity.
